jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one attack effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. The effect is a round slab of tree-ring wood tipping over and rolling forward left to right. Frame 1 the disc leans back on its edge, its growth rings clearly concentric. Frames 2-4 it rolls forward, the rings blurring into spinning circles with a low dust trail. Frame 6 it strikes at the right with a hard flat impact, splinters and a shock ring. Frames 7-8 it wobbles, loses speed and the dust settles. Palette: warm amber and honey brown, aged brass, dark heartwood grain, restrained pale gold glow.
